content:
**Visual observations:**

- Affected part: whole plant (center-right of image)
- The diseased plant is severely wilted/collapsed, with brown, dried-out leaves drooping downward
- Surrounding plants are healthy green
- The affected plant shows what appears to be a tassel area that is distorted/abnormal — looks bushy and leafy rather than a normal tassel
- The plant appears to be smaller/more compact than neighbors
- Leaves are tan/brown and withered, wrapping around the plant

**Key diagnostic feature:** The tassel region appears to be replaced by a mass of small, leafy proliferations — this is the hallmark of **Crazy top** (downy mildew causing tassel proliferation into a bushy leafy mass). The "crazy top" symptom is exactly this: normal tassel replaced by a large bushy mass of small leaves.

The wilted/brown leaf appearance and the distorted, leafy tassel mass strongly point to Crazy_top. The plant also shows stunting relative to neighbors.

This combination — leafy tassel replacement + stunting + wilted brown foliage — is diagnostic of Crazy_top (caused by Sclerophthora macrospora)."}
